summary: Frontend-only regression + focused testing of new MethodSection and BreathingSection on the static site. All specified data-testids render correctly, CTA scrolls to #contacto, no console errors, no wa.me/whatsapp regressions, scroll-reveal working (56/58 elements revealed; 2 minor never-in-viewport divs remain at low opacity but do not affect UX).
critical_code_review_comments: MethodSection.jsx uses text-transform via CSS (uppercase visually) — DOM text remains title-cased, which is fine; just note that any automated assertions on visible text should be case-insensitive.

2 [data-reveal] elements stayed at opacity<0.1 after full scroll (likely reveals never entering viewport due to layout). Consider a fallback in useScrollReveal to force-show elements after N seconds or when close to viewport to avoid empty spots on very tall screens.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Method section verified: id='metodo', label 'EL MÉTODO METTLE', title 'MÁS QUE ENTRENAR', manifesto contains 'reloj interno' and 'ordenamos tu reloj', highlight text present. All 6 pillars (method-pillar-0..5) render with correct Spanish titles. All 3 breathing-protocol-* cards render with proper patterns (Inhala 4·Retén 7·Exhala 8, Box Breathing, 4/6). wim-hof-card contains 'Método Wim Hof' and 'NUESTRO FAVORITO' tag. method-cta-button (text 'Quiero aprender el Método', href='#contacto') scrolls to contact form. No console errors. Floating WhatsApp button + wa.me link present.
